result.detail: There is one gap against the upstream verification plan. Section 8 of the interface spec and section 5 of the microarchitecture call for a SymbiYosys proof with covers (apb_gpio.sby, apb_gpio_n32.sby), but the expected outputs of this task are rtl_source and testbench only. I did not submit a formal_spec, so no formal evidence requirement is triggered. The proof remains open for a follow-up task or for the tech lead to schedule. The simulation lane at N 32 can reuse the testbench by overriding parameter N. Both files use `timescale 1ns/1ps so that Verilator does not raise a TIMESCALEMOD error.
